title: 3-month Journey in AI Game Dev
author: CharmingHunt128
selftext:
Built in Godot 4 with Claude

Assets from Ludo and Tripo

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: What made you decide to switch to 3d?

replies.author: CharmingHunt128
replies.body: I was trying to push the limit of vibe coding

comments.author: teamharder
comments.body:
Not too bad. A good example of why I use human made assets bought cheap. The first jump to 3d was brutal lol. 

Glad you're finding success in Godot. Most of my stuff is in Unity and Im always tempted to explore outside of that. Keep up the good work! Super happy to see someone else move away from the stereotypical pixel 2d stuff and deck builders.

replies.author: Tommymcflurry
replies.body: Man some guys have played 300 hours wtf lol, you're doing something right that's for sure

replies.author: CharmingHunt128
replies.body:
The usual, do quests and progress until hitting the class change, finishing the story until you defeat the story boss, collecting monster loot and gears for stats, get talent points for building character (PoE grid style), complete the final set defeating the final boss, getting gears upgraded and fully socketted.   
I think people are just trying to complete all the contents, we are all trying to play catch up. Players try to consume all the contents I'm pushing every week. That's the best part of this early access that I can get feedback from the players and I build around that and build the game from what players wants

replies.body: Lol, you didn't include the link in the post, and it's tagged as a demo, so I wasn't expecting it to be playable already. Also, what you said is a good thing, **you're updating it**, that says a lot, it's not just another "unfinished project"

comments.author: Savings-Singer-1202
comments.body: how did you optimized the 3d models? poly wise?

replies.author: CharmingHunt128
replies.body: That is actually my challenge right now. I wanted to keep it pretty and still able to make it playable for lower end hardwares

replies.author: No-Trouble-9138
replies.body:
Consider using Tripo, this is my workflow:

* ChatGPT > generate image or front/left/right/back views, remove background

* Meshy > Model (20 credits)

* Meshy > HD Texture (10 credits)

* Tripo > Retopo > Triangle (5 credits, model max 150MB)

* Tripo > Texture > PBR (5 credits)

replies.author: CharmingHunt128
